run_description: September 2026 month-end supplier payment run, Harbourline Studio Ltd
conventions: One record per document, R01 to R12, same ids as work/invoices.json.
Amounts are strings with two decimals and no separators, in the currency shown on the record.
decision is pay, hold or exclude. exclusion_code uses the payment_run.json set: PAID, VOID, CREDIT, DUPLICATE, STATEMENT, OTHER.

amount_to_pay is the amount paid if the record is released: to schedule now for pay, on release for hold, 0.00 for exclude, null where the document has no amount. Only pay records are payable now; see summary.pay_now_total_gbp.
variance_vs_po is invoice net minus PO net in the invoice currency (positive means the invoice is above the PO). Tolerance is 50.00 net (policy 4).
Payments go to the details on file in data/supplier_bank.json. No change of bank details has been approved (policy 8).
R07 and R09 are earlier or repeated copies of an invoice number that has its own line (R08, R06). payment_run.json keeps one line per invoice number, so they need no line of their own.
extractor_decision is as at the extractor's handoff; anything that changed after the handoff is listed in updates_after_handoff.

The superseded first version (R07) was 310.50 net, 10.50 over.

Policy 7 credit note: CN-012 (R04), GBP 300.00, was refunded by the supplier: bank feed CR 300.00 on 2026-09-10, reference MARLOW DESIGN CN-012 REFUND. Nothing is offset; MD-2026-057 (R06) is payable at its full 5400.00.

Policy 1 non-invoices: R10 is a statement (balance 0.00, agrees with the bank feed), R12 is marketing. PO-1047 (Evergreen, net 180.00) has no invoice; nothing is due against it in this run.

Supplier master: data/supplier_bank.json was read and not edited. Sender domains of all 12 messages were checked against its email_domain column; all match except R11 (northfield-print.co, master northfield-print.co.uk).
Bank feed covers 2026-09-01 to 2026-09-29; it was checked for every invoice and credit note number and amount.

Details not updated; data/supplier_bank.json was not touched by the reconciler; Northfield (R08) is paid to the details on file. The principal will call the number on file and asked that the .co email be treated as suspected fraud.
